resolution_notes: Both free_tier_limits and rate_limits were disputed. Official api-keys page documents free key as 60/min and 50,000/month; docs page still mentions 60/min without key and historically cited 1200/day for keys. Adjudication prefers the current pricing/api-keys source for free-tier and rate-limit wording, correcting the original 1200/day claim. All other fields keep original (null).
free_tier_limits: 60 requests/minute without a key; free API key: 60 requests/minute and 50,000 requests/month
rate_limits: 60 req/min unauthenticated; free API key: 60 req/min and 50,000/month; paid tiers for higher
